stop_reason: After layer 4, two layers were already below the frozen 0.65 control-headroom threshold, making the requirement that four of five layers pass mathematically impossible.

trajectory_diagnosis.interpretation: The control variance is action-budget censored. Workers were still testing or debugging at the final action, so the run cannot establish natural no-transfer variance for the intended experiment.

decision.next_test: Run one frozen three-worker, one-layer no-transfer calibration at 20 actions. Proceed only if mean Core is at least 0.70, at least two workers reach 10/13 or higher, and no worker scores zero because of another exact-boundary stop.
